Mitigations that exist: public history, Apache-2.0 fork rights (https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/LICENSE), a scripted release (https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml). The fix is inviting a co-maintainer

vulnerability_response_process_justifica: https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/SECURITY.md#response-and-disclosure: private reporting, 7 day acknowledgement, status every 14 days, fix or mitigation within 90 days, coordinated disclosure

updateable_reused_components_justificati: no component is copied into the repository; the tools CI uses are pinned in requirement files and updated by Dependabot (https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml, https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/ci/analyze.txt)

automated_integration_testing_justificat: the full suite runs on every push and pull request on Linux and Windows, Python 3.11 and 3.13, with a pass or fail report in the job summary: https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml, runs at https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/actions/workflows/ci.yml

crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: no cryptographic algorithm is chosen by the software; sha256 from hashlib is used only for file digests (https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/codejig/doctor.py), see https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md#common-weaknesses-countered
crypto_credential_agility_justification: the only credential, the gateway key, is read from the environment or the file ~/.config/9router.key, separate from configuration and logs, and replaced without code changes: https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/codejig/rewrite.py (gateway_key)
crypto_used_network_justification: the only network clients are urllib calls with Python's default TLS context (TLS 1.2 or newer, certificate and hostname verified before any request is sent, never disabled): https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/codejig/sources.py reads public pages, and https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/codejig/rewrite.py accepts only https, or http to this machine, and never follows a redirect; see https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/docs/security.md

signed_releases_justification: each release asset has a Sigstore bundle and SLSA provenance, with SHA256SUMS; signing is keyless in CI so no private key is stored on a distribution site: https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml, release https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/releases/latest, verification steps in https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/README.md#verify-a-release
version_tags_signed_justification: git tags are lightweight (https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/tags) and the maintainer has no git signing key; the release assets are signed instead (https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/README.md#verify-a-release) and the tags are immutable under https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/rules
input_validation_justification: untrusted input is checked against an allowlist: paths must be regular files inside the root (https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/codejig/atomicwrite.py, resolve_inside), URLs must be public http or https (https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/codejig/sources.py), the gateway URL must be https or loopback (https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/codejig/rewrite.py), skill cases are validated field by field (https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/codejig/skillcheck.py), tags must match the release pattern (https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/.github/scripts/build_wheel.py); fuzzed by https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/fuzz/targets.py; see https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md
hardening_justification: directory-descriptor and O_NOFOLLOW file access, hard-link and swap refusal (https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/codejig/atomicwrite.py), peer-address checks against private networks (https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/codejig/sources.py), a release digest that doctor re-checks (https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/codejig/doctor.py), read-only workflow tokens, actions pinned by commit and hash-locked CI tools (https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml, https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/.github/zizmor.yml)
assurance_case_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md#threat-model: threat model, trust boundaries, secure design principles and common weaknesses countered, each tied to code or CI
contributors_unassociated_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/graphs/contributors shows one human contributor; the other author is a bot
copyright_per_file_justification: every Python file in the repository, including the skill scripts and eval fixtures under https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/tree/main/skills, starts with SPDX-FileCopyrightText and SPDX-License-Identifier lines, enforced by https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/tests/test_spdx_headers.py and checked by REUSE in https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
license_per_file_justification: every Python file in the repository, including the skill scripts and eval fixtures under https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/tree/main/skills, starts with SPDX-FileCopyrightText and SPDX-License-Identifier lines, enforced by https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/tests/test_spdx_headers.py and checked by REUSE in https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
small_tasks_justification: issues labelled good first issue (https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/labels/good%20first%20issue) and help wanted (https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/labels/help%20wanted), described in https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#good-first-issues
require_2FA_justification: the repository cannot show that two-factor authentication is required or which method is used; GitHub does not publish it for a personal account (https://github.com/settings/security). To be changed to Met only after the owner confirms a TOTP app or security key
secure_2FA_justification: the repository cannot show that two-factor authentication is required or which method is used; GitHub does not publish it for a personal account (https://github.com/settings/security). To be changed to Met only after the owner confirms a TOTP app or security key
code_review_standards_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-review: what the reviewer checks, how a review is done and what makes a change acceptable; merge rules in https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/rules
two_person_review_justification: there is one maintainer, so most changes are merged without a second human reviewer; the pull request rule requires review threads resolved and CI green but no approval (https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/rules, https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-review)
hardened_site_justification: the project site, repository and download sites are github.com (https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig) and pypi.org (https://pypi.org/project/code-jig/), which send Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff and X-Frame-Options deny; check with https://securityheaders.com/?q=github.com%2Fjeancarlos%2Fcode-jig
security_review_justification: no independent human security review has been done; automated analysis and the self-written https://github.com/jeancarlos/code-jig/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md are not a substitute
